_comment: C2 contract fixture — runtime SDK status-report (Cluster → Global Control Plane)
auth: per-Cluster SDK static token — Authorization: Bearer {sdk_static_token}

response_401_token_invalid.message: SDK token missing or does not match any Cluster

response_403_cluster_mismatch.message: SDK token does not own the cluster in path variable

response_409_nonce_replay.message: Nonce was already used — same value cannot be replayed

cluster_degraded_transition.recovery: subsequent valid C2 status-report → DEGRADED → READY

nonce_replay_protection.check: token + nonce must not match lastStatusNonce for that Cluster
nonce_replay_protection.window: overwritten on each new report — only latest nonce is remembered
